## Router Alex
en
conf t

int g0/0
ip add 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.192
no shut

int s0/0/0
ip add 192.168.10.173 255.255.255.252
no shut
exit


ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.10.1

ip dhcp pool AlexPool
network 192.168.10.0 255.255.255.192
default-router 192.168.10.1
exit


ip route 192.168.10.96 255.255.255.224 192.168.10.174
ip route 192.168.10.64 255.255.255.224 192.168.10.174
ip route 192.168.10.128 255.255.255.240 192.168.10.174
ip route 192.168.10.144 255.255.255.248 192.168.10.174
ip route 192.168.10.152 255.255.255.248 192.168.10.174


ip route 192.168.10.160 255.255.255.252 192.168.10.174
ip route 192.168.10.164 255.255.255.252 192.168.10.174
ip route 192.168.10.168 255.255.255.252 192.168.10.174
ip route 192.168.10.176 255.255.255.252 192.168.10.174
